questions.question: A car starts at 3 p.m. at a speed of 50 km/h. Another car follows it at 4 p.m.at a speed of 75 km/h. At what time will the two cars will meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A car starts at 3 p.m. at a speed of 50km/h.

Another car follows it at 4 p.m. at a speed of 75 km/h.

**Calculation:**

Car 1 will cover 50 km till 4 pm

Car 2 will start at 4pm.

Car 1 will cover 100 km till 5 pm

Car 2 will cover 75 km till 5 pm

Car 1 will cover 150 km at 6 pm

Car 2 will cover 150 km at 6 pm.

Both cars covers 150 km from the starting point at 6 pm and therefore, will meet at 6 pm.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1).**

questions.question: The LCM and ratio of three numbers are 1386 and 3 ∶ 7 ∶ 11, respectively. The sum of the greatest and least numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of the three numbers = 3 : 7 : 11.

LCM of the ratio units = 3 × 7 × 11 = 231 units.

Common multiplier = Actual LCM ÷ LCM of units = 1386 ÷ 231 = 6.

Sum of the greatest and least numbers = (11 + 3) × 6 = 14 × 6 = 84.

**∴ The correct answer is 84.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The ratio of three numbers = 3 : 7 : 11

The LCM of the three numbers = 1386

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47d42f287080c1e58cdd82b6b0d7f867ab6e934ddf23ca7d1ba20c559bbc980a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the three numbers be 3x, 7x, and 11x, where x is the common factor.

⇒ Since 3, 7, and 11 are prime numbers, the LCM of these numbers is their direct product multiplied by x.

⇒ LCM = 3 × 7 × 11 × x = 231x

⇒ 231x = 1386

⇒ x = 1386 ÷ 231

⇒ x = 6

⇒ The least number = 3x = 3 × 6 = 18

⇒ The greatest number = 11x = 11 × 6 = 66

⇒ The sum of the greatest and least numbers = 66 + 18 = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Numbers in a Ratio

When numbers are given in a ratio and are co-prime to each other, their LCM is simply the product of the individual ratio parts multiplied by their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

HCF of Numbers in a Ratio

The common multiplier x used to define numbers from a given ratio is always the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of those numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

Numbers that share no common factors other than 1 are called co-prime numbers. For co-prime numbers, their HCF is 1, and their LCM is their direct product.
</p

questions.question: If the number 55p1067q9 is exactly divisible by 99, then pq is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 55p1067q9

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 9:

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Divisibility rule of 11:

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of odd and even places is divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

99 = 9 x 11

For the divisibility rule of 9,

5 + 5 + p + 1 + 0 + 6 + 7 + q + 9 = 33 + p + q = m (m = divisible by 9)

6 + p + q = m

p + q = m - 6

p + q = 3, 12 ( for m = 9 or 18)

Applying the divisibility rule of 11,

Sum of odd places = 5 + p + 0 + 7 + 9 = 21 + p .....(1)

Sum of even places = 5 + 1 + 6 + q = 12 + q .......(2)

Equation (1) - (2), we get,

21 + p - 12 - q = n ( n = divisible by 11)

9 + p - q = n

p - q = - 9 or 2 ( for n = 0 or 11)

 
 

 
 **p + q = 3**
 **p + q = 12**
 
 

 **p - q = -9**
 p = - 3, q = 6
 p = 1.5 q = 10.5
 
 

 **p - q = 2**
 p = 2.5, q = 0.5
 p = 7, q = 5
 
 

p + q = 12 and p - q = 2 gives p = 7 and q = 5

Therefore, pq = 7 x 5 = 35

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1).**

questions.question: If x² + 1over x² = 98, then the value of x + 1over x is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then x + 1/x = √(k + 2)

Here, the given value of k is 98.

⇒ x + 1/x = √(98 + 2)

⇒ x + 1/x = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

x² + 1/x² = 98

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 × x × (1/x)

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

Substitute the given value of x² + 1/x² = 98:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 98 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 100

Taking the square root on both sides:

⇒ x + 1/x = √100

⇒ x + 1/x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

questions.question: Two positive numbers differ by 3951. When the larger number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 12 and the remainder is 13. The sum of the digits of the larger number is:
questions.solution:

Two positive numbers differ by 3951 

When larger number is divided by the smaller number ,

Quotient is 12 and the remainder is 13 

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

**Calculation:**

Let us assume the larger number be x and the smaller number be y 

⇒ x - y = 3951 .............(1)

According to the given question, when larger number is divided by smaller number,

quotient = 12, remainder = 13

⇒ Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

⇒ x = y × 12 + 13 

⇒ x - 12y = 13 ...........(2) 

On subtracting eq( 1 ) - eq (2),we get

⇒ 11y = 3938 

⇒ y = 358 

Now, put the value of y in eq(1), we get

⇒ x - 358 = 3951

⇒ x = 3951 + 358 = 4309 

Sum of the digits of the larger number x = 4 + 3 + 0 + 9 = 16

**Hence, sum of the digits of the larger number is 16.**

Highest Common Factor ( H.C.F) = It is the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, the given numbers are 120, 360 and 210

Prime factorization of these numbers are 

⇒ 120 = 2³ × 3 × 5¹

⇒ 360 = 2³ × 3² × 5¹

⇒ 210 = 2¹ × 3¹ × 5¹

So, H.C.F = 2¹ × 3¹ × 5¹ = 30 [ Highest common factors are 2¹ , 3¹ and 5¹]

**Hence, the required H.C.F is 30 .**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 85% of the voters cast their votes, out which 4% of the votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 6936 votes which were 85% of the valid votes. Find the total number of voters enrolled in that election.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

85% of the voters cast their votes in an election

4% of the votes were declared invalid 

A candidate got 6936 votes which were 85% of the valid votes

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the total number of voters enrolled be 100x

Number of voters cast their votes = 85% of 100x 

⇒ 85/100 × 100x = 85x 

Number of invalid votes = 4% of 85x

⇒ 4/100 × 85x = 3.4x 

Number of valid votes = 85x - 3.4x = 81.6x

Now, according to the given question we have

A candidate got no. of votes = 6936 which were 85% of the valid votes

⇒ 85% of the valid votes = 0.85 × 81.6x = 69.36x

⇒ 69.36x = 6936 

⇒ x = 6936/69.36 = 100 

Now, the total number of voters enrolled = 100x 

⇒ 100 × 100 = 10,000

**Hence, the total number of voters enrolled in that election is 10,000.**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, a candidate secured 60% of the valid votes and is elected by a majority of 180 votes. The total number of valid votes is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

In an election a candidate secured 60% of the valid votes 

Winner is elected by a majority of 180 votes 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the total number of valid votes be 100x

A winner candidate secured 60% of the valid votes

⇒ 60/100 ×100x = 60x 

So, the second candidate must have secured 40% of the valid votes

⇒ 40/100 × 100x = 40x

Difference in votes secured = 60x - 40x = 20x

But according to the given question,

Winner wins by 180 votes

⇒ 20x = 180 

⇒ x = 9

So, the total number of valid votes are 100x 

⇒ 100 × 9 = 900 

**Hence, the total number of valid vote is 900 .**

questions.question: A train crosses two persons travelling at 4 km/h and 6 km/h in the same direction in 12 sec and 14 sec, respectively. The speed of the train is ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train crosses two persons in the same direction in 12 sec and 14 sec respectively

Speed of the two persons is 4 km/h and 6 km/h 

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the train be S and its length be L 

Now, it crosses first person in 12 sec i.e. (12)/(3600) = (1)/(300) h at 4 km/h

Relative speed ,as they move in the same direction = S - 4 

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time 

⇒ L = ( S - 4 ) × (1)/(300) ..............(1)

Also, it crosses second person in 14 sec i.e. (14)/(3600 ) = (7)/(1800) h at 6 km/h 

Relative speed = S - 6

⇒ L = ( S - 6 ) × (7)/(1800) ............(2) 

From equation (1) and (2) we get 

⇒ (S - 4) × (1)/(300) = (S - 6) × (7)/(1800 )

⇒ ( S - 4 ) = ( S - 6 ) × (7)/(6 )

⇒ 6S - 24 = 7S - 42 

⇒ S = 18 km/h 

**Hence, speed of the train is 18 km/h.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Let the speed of the train = y km/hr

Distance = Speed × Time

A train passes a man or a pole covered its length so the distance covered by the train is the same in both cases.

⇒ (y - 4) × 12 = (y - 6) × 14

⇒ 6y - 24 = 7y - 42

⇒ y = 18

**∴ The speed of the train is 18 km/hr.**

k(7x2 + 8) + px + (2x2 − 3) = 0 ------ (eq. 2)

**Calculation:**

Since the roots of the equation are common, the coefficients are in proportion.

The eq.1 can be written as, (21k +14)x² + rx + 24k - 9 = 0

The eq.2 can be written as, (7k + 2)x² + px + 8k - 3 = 0

Therefore,

⇒(21k + 14)/(7k + 2) = (r)/(p) = (24k - 9)/(8k - 3)

⇒ (r)/(p) = (24k - 9)/(8k - 3)

⇒ (r)/(p) = 3times ((8k - 3))/((8k - 3))

⇒ (r)/(p) = (3)/(1)

⇒ (p)/(r)=(1)/(3)

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

questions.question: The average score in an English exam of a class of 45 students in a coaching centre is 52. A group of 6 boys having an average score of 40 leave the class and another group of eight boys having an average score of 43 join the class. What is the new average score of the class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total number of students in the coaching centre is 45

The average score of 45 students is 52.

The number of students leaving the coaching centre is 6.

The average of students leaving class is 40.

The number of students joining the coaching centre is 8

The average score of 8 boys joining the class is 43.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all the scores of the students / No. of students

**Calculation:**

Sum of the scores of all the 45 students = Average × No. of students = 52 × 45 = 2340

A group of 6 boys leaving the class, average score is 40

Sum of the scores of 6 boys = Average × No. of students = 40 × 6 = 240

Sum of the scores of 8 boys joining the class = Average × No. of students = 43 × 8 = 344

Average score of the class = ([Sum of the scores of all the 45 students - Sum of the scores of 6 boys leaving the class + Sum of the scores of 8 boys joining the class] )/([Total number of students - No. of students leaving + No. of students joining the class])

Average score of the class = ([2340 - 240 + 344])/([45 - 6 + 8])

Average score of the class = (2444 )/( 47) = 52

Hence, the average score of the class is 52.
